subject: Readiness checkpoint: clarifying ISO scope, FedRAMP boundary, and evidence owners
messages:
From: Jane Roberts <jane.roberts@helixbank.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pre-audit checkpoint: ISO scope / FedRAMP boundary questions

Hi Monica & Vivek,

Thanks again for agreeing to the pre-audit checkpoint. We’re preparing Helix Bank’s internal audit plan and want to confirm a few scoping items before the kickoff call next week. Attaching a short questionnaire (Helix_PreAudit_Questions_v2.docx) with the items below — quick asks to help our evidence intake team route requests efficiently:

- ISO 27001: please confirm intended scope ("product inference service" vs. "platform-wide including CI/CD and corporate employees"). Which internal teams will be control owners?
- FedRAMP: are you planning to pursue Low or Moderate? For Moderate, we’ll need boundary diagrams and network segmentation details up front.
- SIG/CAIQ: do you have an existing mapping (SIG-to-control owners) or should we intake a full CAIQ?
- SOC 2: planned testing window and point-in-time (Q4 preferred for us); any blackout windows we should avoid?
- Evidence cadence: preferred method for uploads (Drive folder vs. secure intake portal) and SLAs for turnaround on evidence items.

Can we pencil a 45-minute checkpoint on Wed 9/15 or Thu 9/16? I’ve copied our Audit Ops mailbox for scheduling.

Regards,
Jane Roberts
Lead Auditor, Third-Party Assurance
Helix Bank

Attachments: Helix_PreAudit_Questions_v2.docx (docx)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Jane Roberts <jane.roberts@helixbank.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-12T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pre-audit checkpoint: ISO scope / FedRAMP boundary questions

Hi Jane — thanks for the clear list. Quick confirmations and next steps from our side: 

- ISO scope: our proposed scope is the inference platform (model runtime, request routing, KV/prefix caching, and the customer data plane). We would like to exclude corporate HR/payroll systems from scope for now; if the auditors prefer an expanded scope we can discuss. Control owners: Olga (Security) for runtime/network, Jordan (Platform Eng) for CI/CD evidence, Monica (Product Security) for data classification and access control docs.
- FedRAMP: currently targeting Low for our initial government customers; we may consider Moderate later but won't be pursuing Moderate for this calendar year.
- SIG/CAIQ: Olga is pulling together a SIG baseline. I’m attaching a draft evidence tracker (redwood_draft_evidence_tracker_v1.xlsx) — it maps likely control owners and an initial intake column.
- SOC 2: we are planning a Q4 testing window (target: 2027-11-01 to 2027-11-15). No major blackout windows for Prod, but we will freeze deploys for the selected test window.
- Evidence intake: Drive folder + HubSpot ticketing works best for us; we’ll turn around most requests within 3 business days but medium-complexity items may need 7-10 business days.

Prefer Wed 9/15 at 10:00am PT for the checkpoint; Jordan and Olga will join to walk the mapping and the draft boundary diagram. If that works I’ll accept a calendar invite from Audit Ops.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Security Programs Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_draft_evidence_tracker_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Jane Roberts <jane.roberts@helixbank.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-12T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pre-audit checkpoint: ISO scope / FedRAMP boundary questions

On 2027-09-12 11:03, Monica Patel wrote:
> - SIG/CAIQ: Olga is pulling together a SIG baseline. I’m attaching a draft evidence tracker...

Hi all — attaching the SIG/CAIQ mapping PDF (SIG_CAIQ_control_mapping.pdf). A few notes from my review: 

- We have an existing CAIQ export from our last external request (Q2) that covers baseline configuration and identity management. I’ve mapped the CAIQ to internal owners for the items that will be in-scope for the inference platform.
- Network diagrams: Jordan will share a boundary diagram (VPC/subnets, NATs, peering, and the customer egress pattern). For FedRAMP Low we’ll include the architecture diagram and ACLs; if auditors later request Moderate-level segmentation we’ll add host-level segmentation docs.
- Evidence owners & SLAs: I propose the following owners and turnaround commitments: Runtime logs (Platform Eng / Jordan) — 3 business days; KMS attestations (Security / Olga) — 5 business days; Deployment pipeline evidence (Platform Eng) — 7 business days for historical runs.
- SOC 2 testing: we need to lock test case owners for availability and change management items by 9/24 to meet the Nov testing window.

I’ll upload the SIG_CAIQ_control_mapping.pdf to the shared Drive and flag the required artifacts in the tracker.

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SIG_CAIQ_control_mapping.pdf (pdf)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-13T08:50:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pre-audit checkpoint: ISO scope / FedRAMP boundary questions

Thanks team — quick note from exec side: please ensure any customer PII flow diagrams are redacted before upload and verify that our canary model (experimental infra) is out of scope and blocked from evidence snapshots. Also add a HubSpot ticket for procurement artifacts (contract redlines, DPA) and share the ticket ID in the tracker so Audit Ops can pull contracts quickly.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Product & Platform, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Jane Roberts <jane.roberts@helixbank.com>, Audit Ops <audit-team@cloudaudits.io>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-13T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pre-audit checkpoint: ISO scope / FedRAMP boundary questions — meeting confirmed

Jane / Audit Ops — thanks. Confirmed items and next steps before our 9/15 checkpoint at 10:00am PT: 

Action items:
- Jordan: upload boundary diagram + VPC/Subnet inventory to Drive by 9/14 EOD (redwood_draft_evidence_tracker_v1.xlsx ref column C).
- Olga: finalize SIG_CAIQ_control_mapping.pdf and tag required artifacts in the Drive (done — uploaded).
- Monica: create HubSpot ticket HS-67219 and add procurement artifacts (contract DPA, security addendum).
- All: redact any customer PII from flows before upload.

Meeting details: 9/15/2027 10:00am PT — Zoom invite sent by Audit Ops. Please come prepared to walk the evidence tracker and accept/assign control owners in the sheet.

Thanks — looking forward to the checkpoint.

Monica Patel
Security Programs Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: redwood_draft_evidence_tracker_v1.xlsx, SIG_CAIQ_control_mapping.pdf
